title: Roto-Lith, Ionics, and the conditional-acceptance debate
shortTitle: Roto-Lith, Ionics, and the conditional-acceptance debate
summary: Dorton’s notes preserve competing readings and a reported later rejection of the broad Roto-Lith approach.
notes: The text describes extensive criticism and the later Ionics reversal of that approach. This is dated subsequent history supplied by the casebook. The different conditionality standards should not be compressed into a claim that all courts always required Dorton’s exact language.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 279–281. Open assigned page 279.
